evidence.claim: Ultralytics v8.2.0 tag LICENSE is the GNU AGPL v3 (2007-11-19) full text and byte-identical to the FSF AGPL-3.0 text.
evidence.evidence_domain: official files, N=2 (Ultralytics v8.2.0 LICENSE + gnu.org agpl-3.0.txt)
evidence.quote: GNU AFFERO GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE / Version 3, 19 November 2007

evidence.claim: Ultralytics README declares a dual license: AGPL-3.0 for open source; commercial use may buy an Enterprise License that bypasses AGPL open-source requirements.
evidence.quote: AGPL-3.0 License ... Enterprise License: Designed for commercial use, this license permits seamless integration of Ultralytics software and AI models into commercial goods and services, bypassing the open-source requirements of AGPL-3.0.
evidence.note: No commercial license application was made and no commercial license text was obtained in this task.

evidence.claim: AGPL section 13 requires a modified version that supports remote network interaction to offer Corresponding Source to remote users; the clause itself does not decide onboard inference or weight status.
evidence.quote: if you modify the Program, your modified version must prominently offer all users interacting with it remotely through a computer network (if your version supports such interaction) an opportunity to receive the Corresponding Source of your version ...

evidence.topic: AGPL covered work / modified version definitions
evidence.claim: Covered work means the unmodified Program or a work based on the Program; modified version is defined via copying/adapting.
evidence.quote: A covered work means either the unmodified Program or a work based on the Program.

evidence.claim: AGPL states that output from running a covered work is covered only if the output itself constitutes a covered work; this is the key unresolved hinge for trained weights.
evidence.quote: The output from running a covered work is covered by this License only if the output, given its content, constitutes a covered work.

evidence.claim: Corresponding Source includes all source needed to generate, install and run the object code, and source for shared libraries/dynamically linked subprograms the work is specifically designed to require.
evidence.quote: Corresponding Source includes interface definition files ... and the source code for shared libraries and dynamically linked subprograms that the work is specifically designed to require ...

evidence.claim: PyPI ultralytics 8.2.0 uploaded 2024-04-17T04:38:42, license field AGPL-3.0, requires_python >=3.8, dependency torch>=1.8.0, export extra onnx>=1.12.0, classifiers Python 3.8-3.12.
evidence.quote: requires_python >=3.8; torch>=1.8.0; onnx>=1.12.0 (export extra); License :: OSI Approved :: GNU Affero General Public License v3 or later (AGPLv3+)

evidence.claim: v8.2.0 docs describe the pose task, -pose model names, and the CLI yolo pose train with a yolov8n-pose.pt model.
evidence.quote: YOLOv8 pose models use the -pose suffix, i.e. yolov8n-pose.pt ... yolo pose train data=coco8-pose.yaml model=yolov8n-pose.pt epochs=100 imgsz=640

evidence.topic: kpt_shape data format and custom datasets
evidence.claim: v8.2.0 dataset guide documents kpt_shape as [number of keypoints, dims] with dims 2 or 3, optional flip_idx, a 12-keypoint animal-pose example, and guidance for custom datasets.
evidence.quote: kpt_shape: [17, 3]  # number of keypoints, number of dims (2 for x,y or 3 for x,y,visible) ... If you have your own dataset ... ensure that it follows the format specified above

evidence.claim: v8.2.0 reads kpt_shape from the data yaml, raises if missing/invalid, PoseTrainer passes data kpt_shape into PoseModel(data_kpt_shape=...), and PoseModel overrides the model yaml kpt_shape.
evidence.quote: nkpt, ndim = self.data.get('kpt_shape', (0, 0)) ... raise ValueError(...) ; model = PoseModel(cfg, ch=3, nc=self.data['nc'], data_kpt_shape=self.data['kpt_shape']); if any(data_kpt_shape) and list(data_kpt_shape) != list(cfg['kpt_shape']): cfg['kpt_shape'] = data_kpt_shape

evidence.claim: BaseModel.load uses intersect_dicts keeping only same-name same-shape tensors, so a 17-keypoint pretrained pose head is not transferred to a 1-keypoint head.
evidence.quote: def intersect_dicts(da, db, exclude=()): return {k: v for k, v in da.items() if k in db and ... and v.shape == db[k].shape}

evidence.claim: v8.2.0 export docs give yolo export model=... format=onnx and args imgsz/half/dynamic/simplify/opset; opset None means latest supported.
evidence.quote: yolo export model=path/to/best.pt format=onnx ... opset: If not set, uses the latest supported version.

evidence.claim: export docs do not state pose-specific restrictions; ONNX is a generic format; exporting requires onnx (export extra onnx>=1.12.0).

evidence.topic: pose to ONNX exists in official ecosystem
evidence.claim: RKNN Model Zoo provides a yolov8n-pose.onnx asset and conversion example, showing pose to ONNX is used in the official ecosystem.
Host torch 2.7.0 has torch.load defaulting to weights_only=True (signature shows weights_only=None, doc signature shows weights_only=True).
evidence.quote: load(f, map_location=None, pickle_module=pickle, *, weights_only=True, mmap=None, **pickle_load_args)

evidence.claim: ultralytics 8.2.0 (2024-04) predates the torch 2.6/2.7 weights_only default; PyPI only declares torch>=1.8.0 with no upper bound and no 2.7 compatibility statement.
Ultralytics later added an opt-in ULTRALYTICS_SAFE_LOAD flag (PR #24829), indicating interplay between newer torch defaults and older loading logic required dedicated handling.
YOLOX repo LICENSE is Apache License 2.0 with appendix copyright (c) 2021-2022 Megvii Inc.
evidence.quote: Apache License Version 2.0, January 2004 ... Copyright (c) 2021-2022 Megvii Inc. All rights reserved. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0

evidence.claim: YOLOX README model zoo table lists YOLOX-Nano 416 input, AP 25.8 val, 0.91M params, 1.08 GFLOPs, weights yolox_nano.pth from release 0.1.1rc0.
evidence.quote: YOLOX-Nano | 416 | 25.8 | 0.91 | 1.08 | yolox_nano.pth

evidence.claim: YOLOX README lists ONNX export and an ONNXRuntime demo (demo/ONNXRuntime).
evidence.quote: ONNX export and an ONNXRuntime (./demo/ONNXRuntime)

evidence.claim: The repo LICENSE covers repository software; no separate weights license text was found on the repo or the weights download page.
Official COCO Terms of Use page is JS-rendered; retrieved HTML only contained navigation/footer; raw repo paths tried returned 404, so the terms text was not obtained.
evidence.note: Do not claim COCO pretrained weights are free for commercial use until the official terms are read.

evidence.claim: Main candidate YOLOv8n-pose, backup YOLOX-Nano; if AGPL is unacceptable, evaluate the backup first, but never switch automatically and never decide on behalf of the user.

evidence.topic: RKNN model zoo yolov8_pose row and RK3576
evidence.claim: RKNN Model Zoo platform list includes RK3576; the model table has a Body Pose yolov8_pose INT8 yolov8n-pose.onnx row listing RK3576.
evidence.quote: Body Pose | yolov8_pose | INT8 | ./yolov8n-pose.onnx | RK3562|RK3566|RK3568|RK3576|RK3588|RV1126B

evidence.claim: Benchmark table column RK3576 @single_core gives 75.0 for yolov8_pose / yolov8n-pose / [1,3,640,640] / INT8; this is an official example benchmark, not our model result.
evidence.note: MUST NOT be reported as our model effect, board acceptance, or navigation capability.

evidence.claim: Release notes: 2.1.0 added yolov8_pose; 2.0.0 added RK3576; current latest 2.5.0 pairs with RKNPU2 SDK >=2.5.0.
evidence.quote: 2.1.0 New demo release, including yolov8_pose ... 2.0.0 Add support for RK3576 ... 2.5.0 | >=2.5.0

evidence.claim: Example README lists platforms incl. RK3576, convert.py fp/i8/hybrid commands, notes the C demo only supports 8-bit quantization, and links yolov8n-pose.pt to the v8.2.0 assets release.
evidence.quote: python convert.py <onnx_model> <TARGET_PLATFORM> <dtype(optional)>; # Currently the C code demo only supports 8-bit quantization

evidence.topic: RKNN convert.py hardcoded calibration and node names
evidence.claim: RKNN example convert.py hardcodes DATASET_PATH to the COCO subset and hardcodes YOLOv8 head node names in hybrid quantization config.
evidence.quote: DATASET_PATH = '../../../datasets/COCO/coco_subset_20.txt' ... custom_hybrid=[['/model.22/cv4.0/cv4.0.0/act/Mul_output_0', ...]]

evidence.claim: The official Python demo post-processing assumes 17 COCO keypoints (kpt_color of 17 entries, 17-point skeleton, reshape(-1,3)).

No official documentation or script parameter is provided for converting/quantizing a custom kpt_shape=1 model to RKNN; the path remains UNKNOWN and requires rewriting conversion/calibration/post-processing and testing.
evidence.classification: 【来源陈述】（缺失即事实）/ 解释性

pending_decisions.subject: AGPL-3.0 acceptance for the main candidate
pending_decisions.impact: If AGPL obligations are unacceptable or unresolved, the main YOLOv8n-pose recipe cannot be trained or distributed; selecting backup or buying a commercial license changes the whole plan.
pending_decisions.minimal_decision_question: Does the project accept AGPL-3.0 obligations? If yes, is it internal research only (no distribution), or is open-source distribution allowed? If no, buy an Ultralytics commercial license or switch to the backup?
options: accept AGPL for internal-only use (no distribution)
accept AGPL and open-source the required parts
buy Ultralytics Enterprise License (terms must be reviewed)
reject AGPL and evaluate the backup route
pending_decisions.default_if_unanswered: no training, no distribution, no deliverable export

pending_decisions.subject: Do self-trained weights and exported ONNX count as derivative works
pending_decisions.impact: Determines whether our trained weights and exported ONNX must be treated as AGPL-covered artifacts; affects any release, demo, or sharing.
pending_decisions.minimal_decision_question: Do we adopt the conservative interpretation that self-trained weights and exported ONNX are based on the Program and thus AGPL-covered (pending written legal opinion)?
options: obtain a written legal opinion first
obtain a commercial license covering weights/ONNX
pending_decisions.default_if_unanswered: treat artifacts as AGPL-covered: do not distribute weights/ONNX

pending_decisions.subject: AGPL section 13 remote-network-interaction trigger scope
pending_decisions.impact: If any deployment form involves remote interaction over a network with modified code, section 13 source-offer obligations may apply.
pending_decisions.minimal_decision_question: Will any deployment form include external network services or remote interaction? If so, who provides the Corresponding Source and how?
pending_decisions.default_if_unanswered: assume section 13 may trigger; do not promise network-facing services

pending_decisions.subject: Allow bounded internal training while AGPL is unresolved
blocks: start of the bounded training experiment
pending_decisions.impact: Decides whether a bounded internal experiment may start before the license decision, with no distributable artifacts.
pending_decisions.minimal_decision_question: Is a bounded, internal-only training experiment allowed (no distribution of weights/ONNX), or must training wait for the license decision?
options: forbid until commercial license or legal opinion

pending_decisions.subject: Backup YOLOX-Nano activation condition
pending_decisions.impact: YOLOX-Nano is bbox-only with classical anchor; switching routes changes the technical plan and does not by itself fix anchor accuracy/recall.
pending_decisions.minimal_decision_question: If AGPL is unacceptable, is the backup YOLOX-Nano (bbox-only + classical anchor) authorized as the first evaluated route?
pending_decisions.default_if_unanswered: no automatic model switch; backup not started

pending_decisions.subject: YOLOX weights and COCO dataset terms
pending_decisions.impact: The repo LICENSE is Apache-2.0, but the weights license text and COCO dataset terms were not obtained; this must be resolved before using COCO pretrained weights.
pending_decisions.minimal_decision_question: Do we accept the risk of unverified COCO-pretrained weight/dataset terms, or require training from scratch / a separate terms review?
pending_decisions.default_if_unanswered: backup route not released for training

pending_decisions.subject: RKNN Toolkit2 proprietary license and conversion artifacts
pending_decisions.impact: Toolkit2 is proprietary under the RKNN SDK License (PRC law); installing/using it in CI and distributing converted models may be constrained.
pending_decisions.minimal_decision_question: Does the project accept the RKNN SDK License? May the toolchain be installed on dev machines/CI? May .rknn artifacts be distributed?
pending_decisions.default_if_unanswered: do not install toolchain; do not distribute .rknn

pending_decisions.subject: Custom 1-keypoint RKNN export/quantization path
pending_decisions.impact: If the custom 1-keypoint model cannot be converted/quantized to RKNN, the intended RK3576 deployment is not achievable with this recipe; this is a training-stage stop condition.
pending_decisions.minimal_decision_question: Is a post-training RKNN feasibility check (custom 1-kpt ONNX -> RKNN i8 -> board latency) required before any accuracy claim, accepting that it may fail?
options: require feasibility check before accuracy acceptance
defer until a board is available
pending_decisions.default_if_unanswered: do not claim RK3576 deployability; no board claims

pending_decisions.subject: 8.2.0 x torch 2.7 compatibility smoke test
pending_decisions.impact: Without an isolated-environment smoke test, training compatibility of the pinned combination is unknown; installation is forbidden in this task.
pending_decisions.minimal_decision_question: Is an isolated venv (.venv/landmark-train) authorized for a minimal load/forward/1-epoch/onnx-export smoke test of ultralytics 8.2.0 with torch 2.7.0+cu128?

pending_decisions.subject: Version pin strategy (8.2.0 vs upgrade)
pending_decisions.impact: 8.2.0 matches the RKNN zoo's referenced yolov8n-pose.pt asset but predates torch 2.7; upgrading may improve torch 2.7 support but breaks alignment with the zoo example.
pending_decisions.minimal_decision_question: Keep ultralytics==8.2.0 (zoo-aligned, unverified with torch 2.7) or allow upgrading to a version officially tested with torch 2.7?

pending_decisions.subject: ONNX opset freeze and RKNN operator support
pending_decisions.impact: Opset affects reproducibility and RKNN operator support; export success and quantization drop are unknown.
pending_decisions.minimal_decision_question: Accept the plan: export ONNX with fixed opset=18, then run RKNN operator/quantization checks, adjusting opset or structure if it fails?
options: require opset decision after operator analysis

pending_decisions.subject: Usage boundary for official benchmark numbers
pending_decisions.impact: Prevents accidental conversion of RKNN zoo example metrics (e.g., 75.0 FPS) into our model effect, board acceptance, or navigation capability.
pending_decisions.minimal_decision_question: Confirm that RKNN zoo's 75.0 FPS is cited only as evidence that an official example exists, never as our model/board/navigation metric?
